details: Japan's parliament has approved legislation that reclassifies cryptocurrencies as financial instruments. This move establishes separate taxation for crypto assets, reducing the maximum tax burden from 55% to a flat 20%, and sets the stage for spot Bitcoin ETFs.
title: Japan Reclassifies Crypto as Financial Asset, Paving Way for Tax Cuts

details: BlackRock's digital asset products experienced a 39% decline in assets under management (AUM) to $48.8 billion by the end of Q2, down from $79.6 billion a year prior, despite receiving $15.1 billion in net inflows over the same period. However, the firm maintains an ambitious target of $500 million in crypto revenue by 2030, indicating continued long-term commitment.
title: BlackRock Digital Asset AUM Falls Despite Inflows, Targets $500M Crypto Revenue by 2030

details: According to Morgan Stanley's Denny Galindo, Solana (SOL) has historically demonstrated better diversification benefits in crypto portfolios compared to Ethereum (ETH), despite SOL's higher volatility. This is attributed to Solana's lower correlation with both Bitcoin and traditional equities.
title: Morgan Stanley: Solana a Better Crypto Portfolio Diversifier than Ethereum

details: The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) has initiated a pilot program to test tokenized stocks and U.S. Treasuries. Nearly 40 financial institutions, including major players like JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Vanguard, and the New York Stock Exchange, are participating in this initiative, signaling a significant step towards integrating traditional finance with blockchain technology.
title: DTCC Launches Pilot for Tokenized Stocks and US Treasuries with Major Financial Institutions

details: Bitcoin's price has consolidated around the $65,000 mark. A softer-than-expected US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report offered some market relief, but ongoing US-Iran tensions concerning the Strait of Hormuz have curbed further gains, leading to a largely neutral short-term market outlook.
title: Bitcoin Holds Steady Around $65K Amid Mixed Macro Signals

details: Coinbase has announced a strategic shift for its Base app, with Jesse Pollak handing over leadership to Cobie. The platform will now prioritize trading functionalities, stablecoin payments, and the integration of artificial intelligence, reflecting a focus on key growth areas within the crypto ecosystem.
title: Coinbase's Base Shifts Focus to Trading, Stablecoin Payments, and AI; Cobie Named App Lead

details: Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, has made a $20 million investment in Uala, a digital bank based in Argentina. This strategic move expands Tether's footprint in Latin America's burgeoning fintech sector and further integrates stablecoins into traditional financial services.
title: Tether Invests $20M in Argentine Digital Bank Uala
